name: Cloud Puff
body:
This cloud of colorful, semi-solid vapor moves through the air by flapping a pair of pseudopods.

Cloud Puff
CR 2

XP 600
N Tiny ooze
Init +3 Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 size)
hp 22 (3d8+9); fast healing 2
Fort +4; Ref +4; Will +2
DR 10/piercing or slashing; Immune ooze traits; Resist acid 10, electricity 10

Speed 20 ft., fly 20 ft. (perfect)
Melee slam +8 (1d2)
Ranged spit +8 (1d4)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks engulf (DC 11, push), push (engulf, 10 feet)

Str 10, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +2; CMB +1 (+5 push); CMD 15
Feats Dodge, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +6, Fly +18, Perception +6
Languages Auran, Common

SQ sighted

Environment any aerial
Organization solitary, pair, or front (3-10)
Treasure standard

Sighted (Ex) Unlike other oozes, a cloud puff has two black spots which function as eyes; a cloud puff is not blind and does not have blindsense. A cloud puff instead has vision equivalent to that of an average human, plus darkvision to a range of 60 feet.

Size Alteration (Ex) As an immediate action taken whenever a cloud puff begins holding its breath, the cloud puff may change its size to Medium by creating a hollow cavity inside its body. (Objects in the cloud puff’s possession are not affected.) The cloud puff remains Medium for as long as it continues to hold its breath. Whenever a cloud puff is Medium as a result of this ability, it gains +8 Strength, –2 Dexterity, and loses all size-related bonuses and penalties.

Spit (Ex) As a standard action a cloud puff can perform any time it is not holding its breath, a cloud puff may spit a pellet of solidified air at a creature or object within 30 feet, dealing damage as if it were attacking with a sling designed for a Medium creature. The pellet spit by the cloud puff vaporizes immediately after either hitting or missing its target.

Cloud Puff (Medium Size)
CR 2

XP 600
N Medium ooze
Init +2 Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge)
Fort +4; Ref +3; Will +2

Melee slam +6 (1d4+3)
Ranged none
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attack engulf (DC 15, push), push (engulf, 10 feet)

Str 18, Dex 15, Con 16, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +2; CMB +6 (+10 push); CMD 18
Skills Acrobatics +5, Fly +11, Perception +6

Cloud puffs are tiny, colorful oozes that are more vapor than liquid, granting them buoyancy in the air. Floating within the body of a cloud puff are a pair of black spots that function as eyes. Each is also able to form as many as four pseudopods at a time. Cloud puffs are intelligent, and have been known to shape themselves into vaguely-humanoid forms in an attempt to elicit feelings of kinship or sympathy in potential humanoid allies.

Any 7th- or higher-level spellcaster with the Improved Familiar feat may take a cloud puff as a familiar, regardless of the spellcaster’s alignment.
